name: Bhagwati Autocast Ltd
tagline: Ahmedabad micro-cap grey/SG/alloy iron castings job-shop for auto, CV, tractor and compressor OEMs — one strong quarter (+28% rev / +54% PAT) and a priority-1 castings/reshoring theme keyword match, but no export/reshoring order disclosure and a weak ~10% five-year growth record
business_overview: Bhagwati Autocast produces high-duty grey iron, ductile (SG) iron and alloy iron castings to international standards for automotive, light and heavy commercial vehicles, tractors, air & gas compressors and other industries, from a foundry near Ahmedabad (Rajoda). Promoter holds ~74%, nil pledge.
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 52.2 Cr (+28.3% YoY, +16.3% QoQ); PBT Rs 5.98 Cr (+49.8%); PAT Rs 4.22 Cr (+53.9%); EPS Rs 14.66
Hit the 20% upper circuit on the Q1 FY27 result
fundamentals_narrative: A small, low-leverage foundry with decent-for-the-industry returns (ROCE ~21%) and a striking Q1 FY27 (+28% revenue, +54% PAT, EPS Rs 14.66, upper circuit). But the multi-year record is weak — ~10% five-year sales CAGR — and no cause for the Q1 jump (a large new order, an export programme, a capacity addition) has been disclosed in what is available. The company presents as a domestic auto/tractor/compressor castings supplier; there is no evidence in its disclosures of participation in the Europe-deindustrialisation / US-reshoring shift that the priority-1 castings theme is about.
technical_read: Re-rated ~107% over the past year and hit the 20% upper circuit on the Q1 FY27 result; micro-cap illiquidity.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread exists (forum search returned nothing in categories 11/14/17). The lead is from an untrusted X-triage batch. No community validation.
community_signal: None (no VP thread; untrusted X lead only).
bse_notes: No SEBI/fraud order; no going-concern issue. Promoter holding ~74% with nil pledge. Related-entity names (Bhagwati Spherocast, Bhagwati Auto Parts) exist in the group — not examined in depth here; note as a light watch-item given the micro-cap size.
bull_case: Strong Q1 FY27: revenue +28% YoY, PAT +54%, hit upper circuit; ROCE ~21%, low debt, ~74% promoter holding
Sits in a priority-1 global theme (forgings/castings — reshoring & Europe deindustrialisation), where a small Indian foundry could in principle pick up export orders
Cheap on trailing numbers (~14x) after a strong quarter
bear_case: Weak multi-year record (~10% five-year sales CAGR); the Q1 FY27 jump has no disclosed cause (order, export programme, capacity)
No evidence of the reshoring/export tailwind actually flowing to Bhagwati — it presents as a domestic auto-ancillary foundry
Commodity job-shop foundry — no pricing power, customer-concentration risk
Micro-cap (~Rs 207 Cr), illiquid, re-rated ~107% in a year; lead is from an untrusted X handle
